content.title: 3 Consumer Stocks with Open Questions
content.summary: Retailers are overhauling their operations as technology redefines the shopping experience. Digitization has been one of the keys to staying competitive against e-commerce rivals, a move that has enabled the industry to grow same-store sales. Consequently, retail stocks have climbed 10% over the past six months, nearly mirroring the S&P 500.
